findings.title: Document the Anthropic global-gate ordering invariant
findings.resolution: Added an explicit invariant that production filtering reads anthropic_models_resolved() after the awaited config write/reload re-installs the global gate.

findings.title: Specify a flippable test gate for post-construction model-manager tests
findings.resolution: Specified a private flippable injected gate for tests so AC4 can prove post-construction behavior without mutating the process-global gate.

findings.title: Require disabled-Claude fallback to update the active model
findings.resolution: Added explicit active-model fallback requirements and cited ChatWidget::set_model/apply_model_and_effort_without_persist as implementation seams.
